text: dsh-balance 是 DeepSeek Harness 的网页插件，提供会话命令和网页 composer dock 余额组件。它通过 /balance 查询账户余额，并在界面显示余额、充值入口和刷新按钮；还按当前会话 token 用量估算费用，并可查看最近每日消费图表。适合希望在 DSH 中核对 DeepSeek 余额和用量的用户。需要配置 DeepSeek API key。

dsh-balance adds a /balance command and composer-dock widget to DeepSeek Harness. It fetches account balance details and provides a top-up link and refresh control. The widget estimates session cost from token usage and charts daily spend from saved sessions. A DeepSeek API key is required.

余额查询命令：在会话中输入 /balance，插件请求 DeepSeek 账户余额接口，并返回各币种总额、充值额与赠余额。
网页余额组件：composer dock 加载余额并显示总额、充值链接和手动刷新按钮，悬停可查看充值与赠余额明细。
会话费用估算：组件读取当前会话 token 用量，按配置的模型价格和时段费率估算输入、缓存命中及输出费用，并提供明细。
每日消费图表：悬停近期用量摘要后，组件读取持久化会话的 assistant 用量事件，按日汇总估算支出并显示柱状图。
使用前须知：查询余额需要 DeepSeek API key，插件优先经凭据服务解析，也可读取启动环境变量；未提供时余额请求会失败。
使用前须知：会话与每日支出是基于 token 量和配置费率的估算；每日图表依赖会话持久化服务中的事件数据。
@deepforce/dsh-balance 提供命令 /balance：Query the DeepSeek account balance

@deepforce/dsh-balance README · dsh-balance：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds a
`/balance` slash command and a composer-dock balance readout to the web GUI, querying the
DeepSeek account balance live.

@deepforce/dsh-balance README · dsh-balance：It calls DeepSeek's official [Get User Balance](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/get-user-balance/)
endpoint and returns the total, topped-up, and granted balance per currency. The API key is
resolved through the credential seam (`ctx.credentials`) or the environment on every call —
it is never written into configuration, into the returned text, or into the browser.

@deepforce/dsh-balance README · Features：- `/balance` — human slash command that prints the full balance breakdown in the session.
- **Web GUI readout** — the conversation stats area (below the cache-hit figure) shows a
  compact `Balance: ¥…` line with hover details (topped-up / granted), a **Top up** link to
  the DeepSeek platform top-up page, a manual refresh button, and an estimated
  **Session ≈ ¥…** spend figure (hover shows the token buckets × unit prices). The readout
  copy is bilingual and follows the active dsh language (Chinese / English). The browser
  fetches the host's `/dsh-balance` route; the API key never leaves the host.
- **Daily-spend chart** — hovering `Last {days}d ≈ ¥…` floats a comic speech bubble upward
  from the summary: a titled SVG bar chart of the last `usageDays` days' estimated spend,
  with a Y axis of ¥ ticks, an X-axis date per bar, and per-bar hover details (date, amount,
  request count, tokens). Moving away closes it. Data comes from the host's `/dsh-usage`
  route, which folds `assistant/message` usage across persisted sessions, pricing each
  request at the tier in effect at its own time.

@deepforce/dsh-balance README · Session-cost estimate：The `Session ≈ ¥…` figure prices the session's cumulative token usage — the same
`tokenUsage` projection the cache-hit stat reads — at DeepSeek's published per-million-token
rates (peak/off-peak, selected by the current Beijing time). It is an **estimate, not a
billing record**: the model used is the configured `estimateModel` (not per-request model
selection), and cache-write tokens are unpriced. Prices can be adjusted through the
`offpeakPrices` / `peakMultiplier` / `peakWindows` config fields.

@deepforce/dsh-balance README · Compatibility：Tested against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` (web profile, Windows 11) and earlier `0.1.0-rc.x`
builds — the `/balance` command and the composer-dock readout were verified live on 2026-08-14
against `0.1.0-rc.6`, and the `0.2.x` port against `0.2.0-rc.2`. Version `0.2.0` requires dsh
`0.2.x`: dsh retired `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` and removed
`sessionPersistence.inspect()`, both of which `0.1.0` used. The npm `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages
are pre-release (no compatibility promise); if a newer dsh version changes the
`conversation.composer.dock` slot or the `webServer` service, re-run the check below and file an
issue.

@deepforce/dsh-balance README · Option A: `dsh plugin` (recommended)：After pushing to GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:deepforce/dsh-balance
```

Replace `github:deepforce/dsh-balance` with your actual git URL. The bundle installs both
halves: the host plugin (slash command + `/dsh-balance` route) and, because the package
declares `dsh.client`, the browser-side composer-dock plugin. Restart `dsh web` after
installing so the client plugin table picks the new entry up.
@deepforce/dsh-balance README · Option B: `--patch` overlay：```yaml

@deepforce/dsh-balance README · balance.cordis.yml：- insert:
    - id: balance
      name: '@deepforce/dsh-balance'
```

```sh
dsh web --patch "$PWD/balance.cordis.yml"
```

@deepforce/dsh-balance README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Credential reference (environment-variable name), resolved per call |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | API endpoint base |
| `timeoutMs` | `10000` | Per-request timeout in milliseconds |
| `estimateModel` | `deepseek-v4-flash` | Model whose prices the session-cost estimate uses |
| `offpeakPrices` | `{input: 1.5, cacheHit: 0.05, output: 4.5}` | Off-peak CNY per-million-token prices (uncached input / cache hit / output) |
| `peakMultiplier` | `2` | Peak-hour multiplier over the off-peak prices |
| `peakWindows` | `[[9,12],[14,18]]` | Beijing-time peak windows as `[startHour, endHour)` pairs |
| `topUpUrl` | `https://platform.deepseek.com/top_up` | DeepSeek platform top-up page the readout links to |
| `usageDays` | `7` | Default historical window (in days) for the daily-spend chart |

@deepforce/dsh-balance README · Usage：- Type `/balance` in the session composer:

```
  Balance (CNY): 110.00
    Topped up: 100.00
    Granted:   10.00
  ```

- In the web GUI, the stats area under the composer shows `Balance: ¥110.00 ⟳`; hover
  reveals the topped-up / granted split, and the ⟳ button refreshes.

@deepforce/dsh-balance README · Security：- `apiKeyEnv` is a credential reference: resolved through the dsh credential service first,
  then the environment. The key is never hard-coded or printed.
- The browser readout only ever sees the public balance figures via the host's
  `/dsh-balance` route; the key stays on the host.
- Only `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` is called; no other data leaves the process.

@deepforce/dsh-balance README · Building locally：```sh
pnpm install        # uses pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides for upstream npm gaps
pnpm run build      # tsc (node half + types) then tsdown (lib/client.js browser bundle)
pnpm run typecheck
```

@deepforce/dsh-balance README · Building locally：The upstream `@deepseek-ai` npm release (0.0.1-rc.1) declares a few dependencies that do not
exist on npm; `pnpm-workspace.yaml` aliases them to the real packages so this repo can
install and build. The dsh runtime resolves those dependencies from its own tree, so the
overrides do not affect the installed plugin.
